verdict.line: You lose if you let Garen's free E spam wear you down before level 3 and get caught by a Q-silence all-in; you win if you trade Q into his E for passive value and time W around his cooldowns.

brief.thesis: Garen has no mana bar, so his E (Judgment) poke is unlimited and his all-in timing is dictated purely by Q (Decisive Strike) cooldown, not resources. Mordekaiser's counter is that every Q and E stacks Darkness Rising, and W (Indestructible) converts exactly the kind of sustained physical damage Garen deals into a heal, which is why the measured numbers give this to Mordekaiser at 50.9% over 690 games despite Garen owning the early poke pattern.

theirWindow.what: He wants Q-silence into E spin and an auto-attack chain, often with Ignite. If you see him walk up with Q available, don't commit to a trade — back off a step or pre-activate W before he closes so the silence doesn't shut down your shield.

yourWindow.what: Walk up and trade freely: Q him for a Darkness Rising stack, then let E tick on him and the wave. He has no silence to punish your W, so this is when you commit to full trades or a level-advantage all-in.

start.why: Only an 11.9% pick but the higher measured win rate (53.3% over 107 games) — the extra regen and auto-attack block directly answers Garen's unlimited E poke and early trading pattern better than the more popular Doran's Ring line.

boots.why: Lower pick rate but the strongest measured win rate (58% over 131 games) here for a mechanical reason: tenacity shortens Garen's Q silence duration, which is the exact window that stops you from activating W in time.

core.why: Slow from Q/E lets you disengage or stick to Garen through his own movement speed steroid from Q.
Omnivamp turns your E waveclear into sustain that outlasts Garen's no-mana poke; this path hits 57.8% over 102 games.
Burn damage punishes Garen's high base HP and completes the highest-sampled build path in the data.

situational.when: he is snowballing and building pure physical damage
you need more sustain against a heavy-damage side lane or jungler
you want more agency to force fights instead of scaling passively

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror ramps off every Q and E hit during extended trades and converts to healing, which stacks with W and Riftmaker to out-sustain a champion who has no mana limit on his own poke.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the most-picked (84.4%) and near-average-WR (50.7%) setup here, and it matches the data's stated solo-kill advantage for Mordekaiser — Ignite closes out all-ins once Garen's W (Courage) damage reduction is down. Flash+Teleport (52.4% over a smaller 9.5% pick share) is the alternative if you want to leverage your E waveclear for proactive TP plays instead of dueling.

playing.title: Trade Q into minions and Garen together
playing.detail: Every Q hit on Garen builds a Darkness Rising stack; get to 3 stacks before committing to your empowered auto for the real damage spike.

playing.title: Pre-activate W before his all-in lands
playing.detail: Once Garen closes with Q up, he can silence you out of casting W — activate it a half-second earlier than feels natural so the shield is already up when Q-E-auto arrives.

playing.title: Don't fight into an available Garen Q
playing.detail: If his Q is off cooldown, disengage or hold at max E range instead of trading; his silence removes your only defensive tool mid-fight.

playing.title: Farm through E even when you can't all-in
playing.detail: Garen has no mana constraint but you have no CD constraint on E for waveclear — use it to deny him easy lane pressure even in trades you're avoiding.

playing.title: Respect his R once you're under 20-30% HP after level 6
playing.detail: Garen's true-damage execute scales off your missing health; don't sit at low HP near him past level 6 even if you think you can out-trade him.

playing.title: Look for your all-in when his Q is down and you have full stacks
playing.detail: This is the window the head-to-head win rate is built on — Q, auto, E, auto is your kill pattern when he can't silence back.

playing.title: Use your own R to close out extended duels post-6
playing.detail: Once Rylai's is online, isolating him with R removes his ability to disengage while your kit still has the sustain edge.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the trade patterns, timing windows, and mechanical reasoning are my own read of the matchup, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Garen when he reachese level 6. Use your skills to farm and contest lane. Wait for a chance after purchasing items with armor.
